topic: A single day on Venus is longer than an entire year on Venus
hook: On Venus, a day is longer than a year.
script: On Venus, a day is longer than a year. Venus rotates so slowly that one full spin takes 243 Earth days. But its orbit around the Sun takes only 225 Earth days. So its day outlasts its year. It also rotates backwards. If you could stand on Venus, the Sun would rise in the west and set in the east. Follow for space facts that break your brain.
